messages:
Sara: FYI opening an after-hours war room — we're seeing a customer-facing spike of 503s + streaming timeouts on /v1/generate in ap-south around 23:08 UTC. Kicking this to incidents.
ops-bot: ALERT: hosted-inference-ap-south: endpoint /v1/generate p50 latency 3.2s -> p95 12.1s, 503 rate 8.4% over last 5m. Related alerts: auth-proxy-504, gateway-conn-reset.
Akshat: @Sara thanks — any specific customer or tenant IDs?
support-bot: Cust IDs: acme-inc (tenant-acme), beta-ml (tenant-beta). Multiple error reports from both. Sample request id: r-0a1b2c3d.
Devon: Can someone grab the edge gateway logs for the sample request id? suspecting conn pool exhaustion or upstream auth timeouts.
Maria: grabbing logs now. quick grep shows repeated 502/503 from inference-runtime behind sidecar for that request id, and auth-proxy reported 504s ~same window.
Tom: If auth-proxy is flapping, fallback routing to another region or model variant could help. Can we enable fallback to eu-west for tenant-acme temporarily?
Akshat: We have capacity in eu-west but cross-region routing requires a config flip. I can enable a routing rule that sends >90% traffic to local but fails over to eu-west on 5xx. Doing it now (will take ~30s).
ops-bot: DEPLOY: routing-rule change started by Akshat — rolling configs to edge routers.
Sara: While that deploys — let's get a repro curl we can run to hit the same path. Put it here so support can reproduce locally.
Devon: repro curl: ```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"gpt-large","input":"summarize: long text"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate``` Note: tokens in logs show short-lived refresh failures around 23:08.
Maria: quick telemetry: KV-cache miss rate spiked concurrently for these tenants, and runtime workers show elevated queue depth. Not just auth. Could be a multi-factor cascade: auth slow -> connections pile up -> worker queue full -> 503s.
Tom: Good catch. Short-term mitigation: 1) fallback routing (Akshat) 2) increase runtime worker concurrency for ap-south pool + temporary queue-size bump 3) enable degraded mode returning cached prefix completions for heavy prefix customers.
Akshat: Routing done — traffic now falls back to eu-west on 5xx. Ops note: all requests for tenant-acme now see ~60% routed to eu-west.
ops-bot: METRIC: 503 rate down to 1.2% within 2 minutes of routing rule. p95 latency back to ~1.4s.
Sara: Nice. Akshat/Tom/Maria — please own short remediation and postmortem. Action items: immediate mitigations taken (routing flip + worker bump). We need a reproducible playbook and a customer comms draft.
Devon: I'll capture the timeline and logs for the sample request id and prepare repro steps for eng-runtime.
Maria: I'll run a controlled load test on ap-south golden cluster to repro queue growth and auth timeout cascade, and share dashboards.
Tom: I'll draft the postmortem outline and recommend permanent fixes: auth-proxy circuit tuning, autoscale for runtime queue thresholds, warm KV-cache strategy for multi-tenant spikes, and a fallback-on-auth-failure policy.
Akshat: Quick note — we temporarily increased worker concurrency on ap-south by +20% and bumped request queue limit from 500 -> 800. Reverting will be manual after stabilization.
support-bot: Customer comms: sent an initial "We experienced API timeouts/503s in AP-SOUTH around 23:08 UTC; we routed traffic to eu-west and performance recovered. Investigating root cause; will follow up with postmortem and action items."
Sara: Nice first touch. Postmortem plan: 1) collect edge+auth+runtime traces 2) reproduce locally with load test 3) identify single root cause (auth vs runtime backlog) 4) define permanent mitigations and owners 5) schedule follow-up review. Owners: Devon (traces/repro), Maria (load test/metrics), Tom (PM postmortem & remediation roadmap), Akshat (routing & infra changes).
Devon: I'll open a postmortem doc and attach logs + timeline. Will include minimal repro script and suggested nightly sim to detect auth latency regressions.
Maria: Action: add an alert that correlates auth-proxy latency + runtime queue depth and fires before 5xx rate >2%. I'll add a draft and send for review.
Tom: Also recommend adding an automated fallback rule: on auth-proxy 5xx/504 surge > 1% for 60s, enable cross-region fallback for affected tenants automatically. We can gate by tenant SLA.
Sara: Agreed. Add that to postmortem action items. Timeline target: initial postmortem draft by EOD tomorrow, full remediation plan in 7 days.
ops-bot: NOTE: incident state -> contained. Monitoring until 01:00 UTC.
Sara: Thanks team. We'll follow up in the postmortem doc and schedule a 30m review in the morning. :eyes: :calendar:
